title: Public rain lifecycle and snow-ring verification
summary: The authored weather checkpoint is deployed on the public app at commit 6935919481b8753d65e3de03851661061b12af3c. Public host verification covers seven rain lifecycle cases and isolated source-derived snow rendering on desktop and portrait browser viewports.
details: Public HTTPS hash validation at https://furyremastered.com/ matched the deployment commit and verified 505 hosted objects and 45 authored static files; the public dev log contained 202 entries and 155 screenshots at the check.

Seven public browser lifecycle cases covered rain selection and chance-on/off behavior across ENV04, NAT06 and SX13, no-rain ENV01, one rain audio voice start/stop, and source rain state with quad 27. The checks completed without page errors.

The isolated Snow browser check changed 35,236 desktop pixels and 42,575 portrait pixels. Both runs showed 60 source-camera rings, one draw, 508,016 GPU bytes, zero render-only upload bytes, no page errors, and preserved frozen/reset/operation-23 clock behavior.
limitation: This verifies the deployed authored implementation and these bounded browser routes only; it does not establish global native RNG/render-queue parity, original ScreenRain callbacks or complete weather behavior. The Snow and rain imagery remains captured in separate host-only entries; this public checkpoint has no new public screenshot.
